after.title: USA Swimming — national organization and directory structure
after.organizationType: National governing body (documented in a national structure reference)
after.summary: USA Swimming groups LSCs into four administrative zones. Article 606 permits regional competition arrangements between LSCs; it does not establish a mandatory zone → region → LSC hierarchy. Region entries in this batch describe competition groupings, not an additional governing tier.
after.geographicCoverage: United States; LSC jurisdiction follows Article 603 rather than state borders alone.
after.coverageNote: Complete inventory of the four zone names; detailed first-zone collection covers Eastern Zone. Nationwide LSC and region collection remains partial.
gaps: USA Swimming’s website lists 59 LSCs, including Lake Erie; 2026 rulebook Article 605 and Central Zone’s current homepage list 58 nationwide / 14 Central LSCs without Lake Erie. Resolve during Central Zone collection; do not assert a single reconciled nationwide total.
National organization is stored as a reference document because the existing Knowledge Base supports document, zone, region and LSC types but has no national-organization type.
No verified national abbreviation is asserted. Corporate suffixes for LSC names are not inferred from naming conventions.
